title: Mailbox contract module: layout, brief renderer, result parsing
action: New module herding/mailbox.rs (mod-wired in herding.rs): (1) path layout .bee/mailbox/<job-id>/ — job.json, result-N.json, log.txt; (2) brief renderer producing a fully self-contained worker prompt per D4: task text, absolute paths, file constraints, the result schema {status: done|blocked, summary, files_changed[], proof}, and the tmp-then-rename write gesture, round number N named explicitly; (3) result-N.json reader: find highest N, parse, schema-validate — missing/invalid = typed error, never silent green. Pure functions only, no process I/O; unit tests for renderer content (absolute paths present, schema block present, round number), result parsing (valid, missing fields, not-json, tmp-file ignored).

truths: Brief is self-contained: absolute paths, result schema, tmp-rename gesture, round number all present in rendered text
Result reader refuses missing or schema-invalid result files with a typed error
